'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Hodur LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hodur]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
